stories.title: Projecting the CFP top 12 after Week 2: How far does Ohio State fall?
stories.summary: We assess how the selection committee could stack the top teams in the country after Week 2.

stories.title: Best of Week 2: Arch’s signature win and two incredible turnarounds
stories.summary: Bounce-back performances from Texas, Michigan and Oklahoma State lead the way.

stories.title: Manning delivers in 4th as Texas stuns Ohio State in 20-point comeback
stories.summary: Arch Manning helped Texas overcome a 23-3 fourth-quarter deficit, leading scoring drives of 15, 13 and 12 plays as the Longhorns stunned No. 1 Ohio State 24-23.

stories.title: 'This one hurts': Day's Buckeyes fold in fourth quarter
stories.summary: No. 1 Ohio State controlled the game for more than three quarters but quickly unraveled in the fourth, dropping a 24-23 decision to No. 4 Texas. "This one hurts," coach Ryan Day told reporters.

stories.title: Sources: Crosby shut down Rams trade talks, wanted to stay with Raiders
stories.summary: The Rams pursued Maxx Crosby shortly after his trade from the Raiders to the Ravens fell through, sources told NFL Network.
